title: Starter kits panel in the site editor's Theme tab: add its pages, replace my pages, or look only

source.ref: Mega Theme lead 2026-10-26: rebuild the kit panel small on a clean branch, reading the Midnight niche variants (LIVE-1355). No picker or switcher.

detail: The Theme tab lists the registered kits (the six Midnight niche variants and the Wildheart coaches kit). Open one and choose Add its pages, Replace my pages (needs a second click) or Look only. Applying loads the kit on demand and commits one labelled editor step, so undo takes it back; block defaults come from the registry; a kit on another theme saves the site theme the way the theme list does. Kit words are sample copy: nothing reaches the live site until the owner publishes. Not built: the full-website entitlement check on add and replace, a side-by-side preview, the sample-copy highlight and publish warning, a picker or switcher.

verify.evidence: Panel, shell wiring and 2 panel tests pass locally with the editor suites (61 tests).
